# TCG Speed Shipper

> Free web app that turns a TCGplayer shipping export (CSV) into print-ready address labels, #10 envelopes and packing slips. Built by a TCGplayer seller. Order data stays in the browser.

- Formats: 4x6 thermal labels (label + packing slip pairs), 8.5x11 sheets, Avery 5160, #10 envelopes, label + slip on one page.
- Plans: Free (10 labels/month, no account), Base $2.99/month (500 labels), Premium $5.99/month (unlimited, paste addresses, Design Studio). Yearly plans give 2 months free.
- Labels are address labels, not postage. Postage with tracking is in testing.
- Independent; not affiliated with TCGplayer, eBay or any card game publisher.
